meaning.en: To deceive one's superiors and hide the truth from one's subordinates.
meaning.zh: 对上级欺骗，对下级隐瞒。

equivalents: cover things up at every level

examples.zh: 他欺上瞒下，把亏空捂得严严实实。
examples.en: He deceived those above and below and kept the deficit well hidden.

examples.zh: 这种欺上瞒下的作风必须纠正。
examples.en: This habit of lying upwards and downwards must be corrected.

meaning.en: To put on a show or pretend, usually insincerely.
meaning.zh: 故意做出某种姿态，故作姿态。

examples.zh: 他拿着书装模作样地看。
examples.en: He held a book and pretended to read.

examples.zh: 别装模作样了，大家都知道你没复习。
examples.en: Stop putting on an act; we all know you didn't revise.

natural: without a soul to turn to

meaning.en: To look around and see no relative or friend: utterly alone in a strange place.
meaning.zh: 抬头看不见一个亲人，形容孤身在外，无依无靠。

equivalents: without a friend or relative in sight
all alone in a strange place

examples.zh: 刚到异乡，他举目无亲。
examples.en: Newly arrived in a strange land, he had no one to turn to.

examples.zh: 她在这座城市举目无亲，只能靠自己。
examples.en: She had no relatives in the city and had to rely on herself.

meaning.en: To be timid and hesitant, afraid of everything.
meaning.zh: 怕这怕那，顾虑太多。

equivalents: be afraid of one's own shadow

examples.zh: 做事不能畏首畏尾。
examples.en: One must not be timid and hesitant in action.

examples.zh: 他畏首畏尾，错过了机会。
examples.en: Over-cautious, he missed the chance.

story.en: Zuo Zhuan: 'If one fears the head and fears the tail, how much of oneself is left?' (畏首畏尾，身其余几).
story.zh: 《左传》：“古人有言曰：‘畏首畏尾，身其余几？’”

antonyms: 吃了熊心豹子胆——胆大包天
老虎头上拍苍蝇——胆子不小
舍得一身剐，敢把皇帝拉下马

natural: want the ground to swallow one up

meaning.en: So ashamed that there is nowhere to hide.
meaning.zh: 没有地方可以让自己藏身，形容极其羞愧。

equivalents: want the ground to swallow one up

examples.zh: 被当众批评，他羞得无地自容。
examples.en: Criticised in public, he wanted the ground to swallow him up.

examples.zh: 想起自己说过的话，她无地自容。
examples.en: Remembering what she said, she was mortified.

usage.en: Predicate or complement, often 羞愧得无地自容.

meaning.en: To be exposed in one's true, ugly form.
meaning.zh: 本来面目完全暴露出来，多指坏人或坏东西。

examples.zh: 骗子的伪装被揭穿，原形毕露。
examples.en: The fraudster's disguise was torn away and his true self was exposed.

examples.zh: 一遇到利益，他就原形毕露。
examples.en: As soon as money was involved he showed his true colours.

synonyms: 荆轲刺秦王——图穷匕首见

meaning.en: Broken walls and crumbling remains: ruins left by war or disaster.
meaning.zh: 残破的墙壁，形容建筑物遭到破坏后的凄凉景象。

examples.zh: 战争过后，只剩下断壁残垣。
examples.en: After the war, only ruined walls were left.

examples.zh: 古城遗址里到处是断壁残垣。
examples.en: The ancient city site is full of crumbling walls.

meaning.en: One blessed by fortune and especially favoured, such as an outstanding young person.
meaning.zh: 受上天宠爱的人，比喻得天独厚、出类拔萃的人。

examples.zh: 他是人人羡慕的天之骄子。
examples.en: He is the golden boy everybody envies.

examples.zh: 考上名校的学生被称为天之骄子。
examples.en: Students admitted to top universities are called Heaven's favourites.

story.en: Book of Han: the Xiongnu chanyu called his people 'Heaven's proud sons' (胡者，天之骄子也).
story.zh: 《汉书·匈奴传》：“南有大汉，北有强胡。胡者，天之骄子也。”

natural: only make things worse by covering up

meaning.en: The more one tries to hide something, the more obvious it becomes.
meaning.zh: 想掩盖坏事的真相，结果反而更加暴露。

equivalents: the more you hide it the more it shows

examples.zh: 他越解释，越是欲盖弥彰。
examples.en: The more he explained, the more obvious it became.

examples.zh: 公司的声明反倒欲盖弥彰。
examples.en: The company's statement only made things look worse.

story.en: Zuo Zhuan: 'Wanting to hide, the name is made manifest' (或求名而不得，或欲盖而名章，惩不义也).
story.zh: 《左传》：“或求名而不得，或欲盖而名章，惩不义也。”

meaning.en: A person capable of bearing heavy responsibility, like a main beam.
meaning.zh: 能担当重任的人才。

examples.zh: 学校要培养国家的栋梁之才。
examples.en: The school aims to nurture the nation's pillars.

examples.zh: 这个年轻人将来必成栋梁之才。
examples.en: This young man will surely become a pillar of society.

meaning.en: To act recklessly and without restraint.
meaning.zh: 不顾一切，任意胡作非为。

examples.zh: 不能让他们肆意妄为。
examples.en: We can't let them run wild.

examples.zh: 有权力的人更不能肆意妄为。
examples.en: Those with power least of all may act without restraint.

meaning.en: To argue with specious reasoning when one is in the wrong.
meaning.zh: 没有理也硬说成有理。

examples.zh: 明明是你错了，还强词夺理！
examples.en: You're plainly in the wrong, yet you keep arguing your way out!

examples.zh: 他强词夺理，谁也说服不了。
examples.en: His forced arguments convinced nobody.

antonyms: 有理走遍天下，无理寸步难行

meaning.en: The one and only way; originally a Buddhist term for the gate to non-duality.
meaning.zh: 佛教指直接入道、不可言说的法门，现比喻最好或唯一的方法。

examples.zh: 勤奋是成功的不二法门。
examples.en: Hard work is the only way to success.

examples.zh: 多读多写是学好语文的不二法门。
examples.en: Reading and writing a lot is the surest way to master the language.

usage.en: Object; often 成功/…的不二法门.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“……的不二法门”。

meaning.en: To harm others for one's own gain.
meaning.zh: 损害别人，使自己得到好处。

equivalents: feather one's nest at others' cost

examples.zh: 损人利己的事，我不做。
examples.en: I won't do anything that profits me at others' expense.

examples.zh: 他这种损人利己的做法令人不齿。
examples.en: His self-serving way of harming others is despicable.

synonyms: 宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我
antonyms: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐

meaning.en: To treat one side generously and the other poorly.
meaning.zh: 重视或优待一方，轻视或怠慢另一方。

examples.zh: 老师对学生要一视同仁，不能厚此薄彼。
examples.en: A teacher must treat pupils alike and not play favourites.

examples.zh: 父母对几个孩子不应厚此薄彼。
examples.en: Parents shouldn't favour one child over another.

usage.en: Predicate; often 不能/不应厚此薄彼.

natural: beset by trouble at home and abroad

meaning.en: Beset by problems both within and from outside.
meaning.zh: 内部和外部都陷入困难。

equivalents: in a bind from within and without

examples.zh: 公司内外交困，濒临破产。
examples.en: Beset on all sides, the company was close to bankruptcy.

examples.zh: 政府内外交困，难以施政。
examples.en: The government, in difficulty at home and abroad, could barely govern.

meaning.en: To dump one's troubles on others, treating the neighbour as a drain.
meaning.zh: 把邻国当作排水的沟壑，比喻只图自己一方利益，把困难或祸害转嫁给别人。

equivalents: pass the buck to one's neighbour

examples.zh: 污水直排下游，是以邻为壑的做法。
examples.en: Pouring waste downstream treats the neighbour as a drain.

examples.zh: 国与国之间不能以邻为壑。
examples.en: Countries must not dump their problems on one another.

story.en: Mencius to Bai Gui: 'You treat the neighbouring states as gullies for your floodwater' (今吾子以邻国为壑).

meaning.en: To treat a matter very seriously and with due ceremony.
meaning.zh: 形容说话做事严肃认真。

examples.zh: 他郑重其事地宣布了这个决定。
examples.en: He announced the decision with due solemnity.

examples.zh: 她郑重其事地向大家道歉。
examples.en: She apologised to everyone in all seriousness.

meaning.en: Strange and dazzlingly colourful.
meaning.zh: 形容现象奇异，色彩繁杂。

examples.zh: 夜晚的大都市光怪陆离。
examples.en: The metropolis at night is a dazzling riot of colour.

examples.zh: 他讲了一个光怪陆离的梦。
examples.en: He told of a bizarre, kaleidoscopic dream.

meaning.en: To slander or wound someone maliciously.
meaning.zh: 怀着恶意攻击、诽谤别人。

examples.zh: 他遭到竞争对手恶意中伤。
examples.en: He was smeared by his rivals.

examples.zh: 网络上恶意中伤他人是违法的。
examples.en: Maliciously slandering others online is illegal.

usage.en: Predicate; often 遭到/被恶意中伤.

meaning.en: Heaven above and the human world below; also a wide gulf between two situations.
meaning.zh: 天上和人间，也指差别极大或相隔遥远。

examples.zh: 流水落花春去也，天上人间。
examples.en: The water flows, the blossoms fall, spring is gone: heaven and earth apart.

examples.zh: 今昔对比，真是天上人间。
examples.en: The contrast between now and then is like heaven and earth.

usage.zh: 多用于诗词，出自李煜词。

meaning.en: To work together with complete sincerity and solidarity.
meaning.zh: 真诚、一心一意地团结在一起。

examples.zh: 只要精诚团结，就没有克服不了的困难。
examples.en: If we pull together wholeheartedly, no difficulty can defeat us.

examples.zh: 全队精诚团结，赢得了冠军。
examples.en: The whole squad united in sincerity and won the title.

natural: work for the public day and night

meaning.en: To devote oneself to public duty from morning to night.
meaning.zh: 早晚都为公事操劳。

equivalents: devoted to public duty day and night

examples.zh: 他夙夜在公，从不懈怠。
examples.en: He devoted himself day and night to public duty.

examples.zh: 这位官员夙夜在公，深受百姓爱戴。
examples.en: The official, tireless in service, was beloved by the people.

story.en: Book of Songs, 'Xiao Xing': 'Early and late, in the public service' (夙夜在公，寔命不同).
story.zh: 《诗经·召南·小星》：“肃肃宵征，夙夜在公，寔命不同。”

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

meaning.en: To visit poor households and ask about their difficulties.
meaning.zh: 走访贫困人家，询问他们的疾苦。

equivalents: visit the poor and ask after their hardships

examples.zh: 春节前，干部们下乡访贫问苦。
examples.en: Before the Spring Festival, officials went to the countryside to visit needy families.

examples.zh: 志愿者定期访贫问苦，送去物资。
examples.en: Volunteers regularly visit the poor and bring supplies.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于新闻报道。

meaning.en: Living forces, especially fighting strength that can still be used; originally military.
meaning.zh: 原指军队的有生战斗力量，泛指能继续发挥作用的人力和实力。

examples.zh: 战争中要保存有生力量。
examples.en: In war, one must preserve one's fighting strength.

examples.zh: 年轻人是企业的有生力量。
examples.en: Young people are the driving force of the company.

usage.en: Object; often 保存/消灭有生力量.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“保存、消灭有生力量”。
